input.summary: The PR adds a free-shipping threshold to shippingCents, with a README line and one test. The implementation converts cents to dollars with floating-point division and uses a strict greater-than, so it contradicts the stated "$50 or more" and the repo's money rules.

files.change: Adds free shipping threshold computed in dollars with > comparison
Adds a test at 6000 cents only, no boundary test

findings.title: Off-by-one at the $50 boundary: uses > instead of >=
findings.why: The description and README say orders of $50 or more ship free, but a subtotal of exactly 5000 cents is charged $7.99 shipping.
findings.fix: Compare cents directly: `if (subtotal >= FREE_SHIPPING_FROM_CENTS) return 0` with `const FREE_SHIPPING_FROM_CENTS = 5000`.

suggestion.original:
const dollars = subtotal / 100
  if (dollars > FREE_SHIPPING_FROM_DOLLARS) return 0

findings.title: Threshold in dollars and division by 100 violates the cents-only money rule
findings.why: AGENTS.md forbids converting to dollars in calculations; the constant is also not named with Cents.
findings.rule: AGENTS.md: money is always integer cents

findings.title: No boundary test for the pricing change
findings.why: AGENTS.md requires pricing changes to test boundaries; the test only checks 6000, which is why the 5000 bug is missed.
findings.rule: AGENTS.md: pricing changes need boundary tests
